Fix icon styling in the page context menu

The icons in the page context menu look off and should better match the intended stroke and overall visual style.

This appears in the page context menu flow around pages-view.tsx:366:75 with the Base UI menu stack shown in the report.

Expected outcome: the icon set in this area should use consistent stroke and style treatment.

Implementation notes:

  • Start from the main branch.

  • Use computer use to inspect the UI in the running app and verify the visual result in context.

  • When testing, use the provided login credentials for the specified user account.

  • Evaluate the current icon treatment before making changes, then confirm the updated icons match the surrounding stroke, sizing, spacing, and overall style.

  • Test the affected context menu flow directly in the app after the change.

  • Validate that the fix does not introduce visual regressions in nearby menu items or related icon usage.

  • Check the result in the relevant interaction states, including default, hover, and any visible selected or disabled states.

  • When the fix is complete and the result is satisfactory, create a pull request.

  • Include a demo video showing that the issue is resolved.
